Name: Albedo (GI) Custom NPC
Author: Chastnyy
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JrfKYZi.png[/img]

[quote]﻿Hello everyone 
Before proceeding, please note that this is my first time ever making a mod so it might not be perfect. If anyone is interested in editing or expanding this mod, you have my permission to upload it as a new mod on Nexus. I'll be sure to improve things here and there overtime, but for now please enjoy!

Special thanks to the SDV Discord Modders community. This mod can't be properly realized without them[/quote]
== Description ==

[b]Albedo[/b] is a custom NPC that you can add in your Stardew Valley that functions like any other NPC in game. He [b]does not replace[/b] any existing NPC. Some of his function includes:

- [b]Date[/b] and [b]Marry[/b] him
- His own customized [b]Spouse room & patio[/b] after marriage
- Shows up in [b]any[/b] currently known festivals
- He is compatible with [b]extension mod[/b] like Stardew Valley Expanded, you can download it through 'Optional Files' tab. (I am not sure with the other extension, do let me know if it's not compatible with your other extension!) 
- His birthday is set in [b]Fall 13[/b] like his canon birthday (13th September).
- Heart Events stretching to [b]11th Heart[/b] (Turned the 10th Heart into 11th to avoid any bugs and glitches, will fix later).
- [b]Added[/b] a new location: Laboratory Cave. Located in the east part of the mine.
- [b]Edited[/b] some location: Adventure's Guild, Mine (Be sure you didn't have other mods that modified these locations to avoid any problems).

If you have any sort of suggestions, feel free to make a post about it!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/JbdZHzB.png[/img]
[size=1]The listed bugs are bugs that I've known as of now. Will delete if it fixed and stay if it isn't. I will also stated that if whether I will fix this soon or later or not at all.
[b]If there's other bug that I haven't listed please let me know.[/b] Be sure to be updated here every once in awhile. I'll make a post of it's a huge update.[/size]

- His flower dance dialogue aren't his written dialogue, so he can suddenly be out of character. Fix soon
- His lack of dialogue in [b]theater lobby,[/b] so you may not be able to talk to him there. [b]( In process of searching why )[/b]
- He will just faced [b]up[/b] whenever he's asleep, a small issue (and a cute one) but I'll fix this soon.
- In his [b]Four-Heart[/b] event, If you play in a custom farm map, the event may not warp you instantly at the farm when the event ends. [b]Might not fix this? as I am unable to find a solution in this.[/b]
- Because of the location of his added Laboratory cave, Albedo would [b]destroy [/b]the rock in the east part of mine that would block us from finding the dwarf. [b]This may not be fixed at all [/b]seeing how it doesn't effect our progress that much. (You don't need to worry about this one if you play the SVE version)

!! If you found any other bugs or error that I haven't listed in any version, please let me know !!
﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nTvxj3I.png[/img]﻿

- Install [b]SMAPI[/b] -> https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- Install [b]Content Patcher[/b] -> https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
- Download this mod
- Unzip it
- Move the folder in the [b]Stardew Valley mod [/b]folder
- Done (If you're still confused, try to search the basic tutorial to download stardew mod in youtube).
